responsibility: Implements encoding and decoding of Go identifiers, package-path components, and struct tags into assembler-safe symbol-name fragments. It owns the underscore/hex/Unicode mangling scheme used by symbol generation code, including UTF-8 decoding, leading-digit handling, reverse demangling for debugging, and escaping of struct tags embedded in type-literal encodings.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual mangling/demangling algorithms for identifier and struct-tag encoding, including UTF-8 decoding, underscore/hex escape mapping, and leading-digit handling. Unlike go-encode-id.h, this file contains the encoding scheme mechanics rather than just the callable helpers.
